topic.title: Drawing Different Shapes
topic.description: Draws polygons from triangle to decagon, each with a random color. Applies the exterior angle formula (360 / sides) and nested loops.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Calculating exterior angles for regular polygons and using a nested loop to draw each shape in a different random color.
learningNotes.challenges: Getting the angle formula right and understanding why 360 / n works for any regular polygon.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Draw stars using different angle calculations.

files.description: Draws triangle to decagon with random colors.
